sparse_val.description: DanceTrack validation with reciprocal appearance and native-gain candidate gates.

online_test.description: Original-rate shared-core reference using the frozen Full association base. The archived test system also uses TWiX motion affinity.

archived_test.description: The archived benchmark system adapts a 64-coefficient TWiX input for legal OLD actions, using a DanceTrack-trained YOLOX-X detector and two trained LMBN encoders.
